description:
Software Engineering – Python – Advanced Role Overview
 We are looking for an experienced Python Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance software solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on expertise in Python development, backend engineering, API development, cloud technologies, and modern software engineering practices.
Key Responsibilities
 
 Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable applications and backend services using Python .

 Build robust and reusable components, APIs, microservices, and integrations.

 Develop RESTful APIs and integrate with internal and external systems.

 Write clean, maintainable, well-tested, and production-ready code.

 Troubleshoot complex technical issues and optimize application performance.

 Work with databases, data models, caching, and asynchronous processing.

 Implement secure coding practices, authentication, authorization, and API security.

 Collaborate with Product Managers, Architects, DevOps, QA, and other engineering teams.

 Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and architecture decisions.

 Develop automated unit, integration, and functional tests.

 Work with CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices.

 Monitor applications in production and support troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.

 Contribute to technical documentation and engineering best practices.

 Required Skills
 
 Advanced proficiency in Python with strong knowledge of Python 3.x.

 Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and design patterns .

 Experience with Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django .

 Strong experience developing REST APIs and microservices .

 Good understanding of SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle.

 Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, or Redis is preferred.

 Strong knowledge of Git and version-control practices.

 Experience with unit testing frameworks such as PyTest or unittest .

 Knowledge of asynchronous programming using asyncio and related Python frameworks.

 Experience with Docker and containerized application development.

 Understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices.

 Strong debugging, problem-solving, and performance-optimization skills.

 Cloud & Modern Engineering
 
 Experience working with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or GCP .

 Understanding of cloud-native application development and distributed systems.

 Experience with messaging/event-driven technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or SQS is preferred.

 Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration is a plus.

 Exposure to observability tools, logging, monitoring, and application performance management.

 AI / Agentic AI – Preferred
 
 Exposure to Generative AI, LLMs, or AI-enabled applications is preferred.

 Experience integrating LLM APIs or AI services into Python applications is a plus.

 Familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI SDK, or similar agentic AI frameworks is desirable.

 Understanding of API-based integration with AI/ML platforms and model-serving infrastructure is an advantage.

 Education & Experience
 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field .

 Typically 5+ years of software engineering experience , with strong hands-on Python development experience.

 Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.

 Strong communication and collaboration skills.

 Ability to independently analyze complex technical problems and deliver scalable solutions.

 Nice to Have
 
 Experience designing highly scalable distributed systems.

 Knowledge of system design and software architecture.

 Experience with event-driven and asynchronous architectures.

 Experience in financial services, enterprise applications, or other large-scale environments.

 Exposure to security, observability, and performance engineering.

 
  

 Compensation, Benefits and Duration 

 Minimum Compensation: USD 42,000

 Maximum Compensation: USD 147,000

 Compensation is based on actual experience and qualifications of the candidate. The above is a reasonable and a good faith estimate for the role.

 Medical, vision, and dental benefits, 401k retirement plan, variable pay/incentives, paid time off, and paid holidays are available for full-time employees.

 This position is available for independent contractors

 No applications will be considered if received more than 120 days after the date of this post
